svg.text: DATA AND I2C — FUNCTIONAL BLOCK DIAGRAM
Addresses are 7-bit I2C; INT lines are the default map the master learns at boot
0x10 · INT_9 · in Info Disp 1 slot P2
RST out, pin 2 (10 ms low pulse)
idle in firmware, no unit fitted
Panel Hub on Ctrl Module CN3
Sys Info: XIAO RP2350, no USB,
34-pin panel cable (12 V, I2C, RST, INT, safe)
16-pin module slot (12 V, I2C, RST, one INT)
I2C BUS: 400 kHz, pulled up to 3.3 V at the master's LTC4311; every module and display is a target. INT: one active-low
line per module, no wired-OR. Safe lines are active-high. RST reboots the four 7" display drivers (and the expansion);
the ATtiny816 modules and the Sys Info Display do not use it. Each 7" driver: I2C target on Wire2 (24/25), INT out pin 0,
RST in pin 1; its FT5316 touch panel is on its own software I2C bus (pins 4/5), not the module bus. On each Teensy the
first USB serial port is debug, the second its Kerbal Simpit port (Section 7.3).
